method: Read the pinned current roadmap sections and native source APIs; compare the exact supplied theorem scope against the consumers; assign each needed extension to a named local target; re-read the integrated English/Japanese result in R1–R3.
meaning: A referenced roadmap is a specification, not evidence that its target is implemented. Native source checks identify actual carriers/APIs. Mathematical truth of all proposed targets is not certified by file existence or source hashes.

final_contracts.supplied: Complex inverse/implicit-function and tangent calculus; holomorphic germs and one-variable meromorphic germs; holomorphic bundle/sheaf equivalence and nonsingular flat connections/local systems; projective charts.
final_contracts.owned_here: N owns nonlinear connections, holomorphic ODEs, transport and observations. M owns meromorphic/analytic-moduli comparisons. K4 does not supply algebraic analytification.

final_contracts.supplied: Smooth Ehresmann splittings, proper-submersion and principal-connection transport within their respective hypotheses.
final_contracts.owned_here: N1.1–N1.5 own nonlinear connection objects, continuous-time local lifting, holomorphic parameter dependence and complete nonlinear transport. No properness of the phase projection is assumed.

final_contracts.supplied: Finite-dimensional manifolds, charts and smooth local/maximal/time-dependent flows.
final_contracts.owned_here: N1.2 proves the continuous-time locally uniformly Lipschitz theorem; N1.8 constructs intrinsic jets; N1.9 proves finite-chart stability and no exit.

final_contracts.supplied: Native covering, path and homotopy lifting, universal covers and their fundamental-group interfaces.
final_contracts.owned_here: N1.5 constructs the nonlinear action and horizontal descent; general-cover descent uses the actual fiber relation, not deck invariance without normality.

final_contracts.supplied: Genus-zero Möbius normalization and supported point-pushing; stable marked-curve deformation charts in the stable range.
final_contracts.owned_here: M1.2 constructs unstable one-/two-pointed quotient charts, finite jets, local markings and determinant transport. Its analytic category is constructed there; D2.0 is only an instance comparison.

final_contracts.supplied: Stackification, 2-fiber products, algebraic/DM presentations, inertia, QCoh descent, and finite-inertia Keel–Mori at its hypotheses.
final_contracts.owned_here: M2.1 proves bounded GIT, scalar Gm rigidification, gerbe and coarse comparisons. Finite-inertia criteria do not apply to an unrigidified Gm stable stack.

final_contracts.supplied: Categorical/geometric quotient definitions, Artin bootstrap and the stated finite-group projective quotients.
final_contracts.owned_here: Reductive invariant theory and actual character quotients are M2.1/M4.1; wild framing and Stokes quotients are P4.2.

final_contracts.supplied: Noetherian projective Quot/Hilbert and Hom/Isom parameter spaces with their stated base-change laws.
final_contracts.owned_here: M2.1 proves boundedness, the equations and stability/GIT comparison. Analytic pullbacks use M1.2.

final_contracts.supplied: Čech and sheaf cohomology, coherent terms, relative/Serre duality, degrees and curve Riemann–Roch at the stated hypotheses.
final_contracts.owned_here: M2.2 constructs C-linear differential-operator hypercohomology and the ramified cone; coherent underlying terms do not make its differential O-linear.

final_contracts.supplied: Artinian coefficients, deformation functors, hulls and elementary small-extension obstruction calculations.
final_contracts.owned_here: M2.2 constructs actual connection cocycles, the needed arbitrary finite square-zero kernels and framed versality; M3.1 constructs strong horizontal extensions.

final_contracts.owned_here: M1.2 constructs general complex analytic spaces, nilpotent quotients, analytification and GAGA comparisons.

final_contracts.supplied: Proper coherent pushforwards and separately stated flat-base-change and cohomology/base-change criteria; Grauert under its reduced-base and constant-rank assumptions.

final_contracts.supplied: Disc and null-homologous piecewise C¹ contour Rouché theorems and zero multiplicities.
final_contracts.owned_here: A1.6 supplies the actual boundary cycle and winding characterization for its general domain theorem.

final_contracts.supplied: Scalar convergent meromorphic germs, finite principal parts and holomorphic remainders.
final_contracts.owned_here: C1.1 supplies finite-dimensional coefficient comparison, the cancellation identity and compact-uniform parameter limits.

final_contracts.supplied: Positive/negative real Lie–Poisson conventions and fiber-negation comparison.

final_contracts.owned_here: P10.4 constructs the intrinsic phase-point/jet bridge. P10.3 proves its tau normalization, sectorial calibration and selected connection constants.

final_contracts.supplied: Gamma and its pole-free analytic theory, Euler–Mascheroni constant, Bernoulli coefficients and native complex analysis.
final_contracts.owned_here: A1.7 constructs Barnes G, canonical normalization, zero divisor, logarithm branches and the explicit sectorial remainder.

final_contracts.supplied: Topological proper maps and the compact-preimage and base-change properties under their actual topological hypotheses.
final_contracts.owned_here: N1.4 proves complete-lift transfer. M1.2 proves analytic/algebraic comparison; P4.4 proves properness of the actual RH family.
